subject: Headcount redesign: matrix approvals and comp band alignment
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: PeopleOps Recruiting <peopleops@talentpartner.co>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Headcount redesign: matrix approvals and comp band alignment

Team —

I put together a short proposal (attached) to rebalance a set of Q4 requisitions that are currently low-conversion and high-cost to keep us within our FY26 hiring envelope. High level:

- Pause 6 junior IC reqs across Platform and Core AI and convert budget to fund 3 senior IC hires (L5->L6) and 1 Staff-level critical specialist.
- Reassign one open Product Manager req to Q1 and redeploy FTE to onboarding/CS automation.
- Update comp bands for two role families where market movement would otherwise force offer declines.

Attachments: Headcount_Redesign_Q4.xlsx (proposal + numbers), Comp_Bands_Mapping_2026-09.pdf (spotlight on bands & market comps).

Ask: can we get an expedited headcount committee sign-off by end-of-week? If not, we should at least greenlight the band adjustments so PeopleOps can proceed with offers they have outstanding.

I can host a quick 30-min slot tomorrow 10:00–10:30 PT if helpful.

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Headcount_Redesign_Q4.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: Comp_Bands_Mapping_2026-09.pdf (pdf)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, PeopleOps Recruiting <peopleops@talentpartner.co>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount redesign: matrix approvals and comp band alignment

Jordan —

Thanks for the packet. Quick notes after a first pass:

- Band changes look reasonable but PeopleOps needs the comp-band delta per role in a single table (total comp mid / 25th / 75th) so we can bake offers. Can you or Vivek drop that into the spreadsheet tab "OfferReady"?
- For the pause/conversion: we need explicit req IDs for the six junior ICs you propose pausing. Ops can't act without the req references.
- If committee is tight this week, we can approve band adjustments separately but we cannot reallocate committed headcount without finance confirmation. I asked Finance to flag the PO line.

I can take the 10:00 slot tomorrow. Also looping Nora from our external partner to confirm candidate pipeline implications if we slow hiring.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP People & Talent
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, PeopleOps Recruiting <peopleops@talentpartner.co>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount redesign: matrix approvals and comp band alignment

+1 on Jordan's proposal from Eng priorities. A couple practical points from the hiring trenches:

- The six junior reqs (REQ-2041, REQ-2043, REQ-2050, REQ-2052, REQ-2060, REQ-2063) are all in low-conversion stages (interviews scheduled but candidates dropping). Pulling these frees up budget and shortens queueing for hiring managers.
- If we convert to 3 senior hires, we should target a 2–3 week accelerated interview loop and offer leverage. PeopleOps: can you confirm comp band ranges we can offer that won't exceed the reserved FY26 base?
- Markus: if we move PM req REQ-2088 to Q1, we should temporarily run the PM workload via contractors — I can justify 6 weeks of contract coverage within existing ops spend.

I updated the workbook (tab: "ReqIDs + notes"). Jordan, please confirm you can present the updated file at tomorrow's slot.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Engineering

From: PeopleOps Recruiting <peopleops@talentpartner.co>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Nora Chen <nora.chen@contractinghr.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount redesign: matrix approvals and comp band alignment

Folks —

Quick read: we see the pipeline impact if the six junior reqs are paused. Two notes:

1) We currently have three offers outstanding in that cohort (candidates A, B, C) where we have verbal acceptances pending paperwork. If bands change materially, we risk losing them; consider converting those to counter-offers now.
2) We can prepare offer-ready comps if you provide the per-role total-comp midpoints (Laura's ask). We recommend approving the band tweak now and gating headcount reallocation on Finance sign-off.

Attached: none (we used the shared workbook).

— PeopleOps TA Team

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: PeopleOps Recruiting <peopleops@talentpartner.co>, Nora Chen <nora.chen@contractinghr.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount redesign: matrix approvals and comp band alignment

Thanks everyone — notes after the call:

- Action: Laura to sign off on the band adjustments by EOD tomorrow (16 Sep). PeopleOps will lock offers for the three verbal candidates at the adjusted midpoints.
- Action: Finance (Markus) to confirm reallocation of 4 FTEs from Ops contingency to Eng by Friday 18 Sep. If Finance can only confirm 2 FTEs, we will scale hires (2 senior + 2 mid) instead of 3 senior.
- Action: Vivek to run accelerated interview loops; PeopleOps will prepare offer templates.
- I uploaded the final workbook to Drive (link below) and added a short comments sheet with tradeoffs.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/Headcount/2026/Q4-redesign-matrix

I'll follow up with a short status update on Friday.

Jordan
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
